Finish war crimes trial soon
2013-04-11T00:00:47+06:00 | Staff Correspondent
https://www.thedailystar.net/news/finish-war-crimes-trial-soon

The freedom fighters of Bangladesh Muktijoddha Sangsad yesterday demanded immediate completion of the war crimes trial and capital punishment for the war criminals.

They raised the demands at a rally in front of the Jatiya Press Club in the capital.

“Since we, the freedom fighters, are still alive, the government must comply with our demands and uproot the war criminals from Bangladesh,” said Monirul Haque.

They would bring out a procession with sticks from Muktangon to Jatiya Press Club around 11:00am today to resist the “illegal and undemocratic hartal” enforced by pro-Jamaat Islami Chhatra Shibir, declared the freedom fighters.

Over 300 members of the organisation participated in a procession before the rally and protested the 36-hour hartal enforced by the BNP-led 18-party opposition.

Emdad Hossain Motin, secretary general (admin) of the sangsad, protested the hartal called by Hefajat-e Islam and criticised the group for making “illogical and irrational demands”.
